<!-- released: 2026-11-10 -->
bossdetox.ing is now in the Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/bossdetoxing/kimmdnobgafbdcjnnaadphlbgacflffi. Installs from the store update themselves.

Rather not install anything? Use the app at https://ass.bossdetox.ing on any phone or computer.

**What's in 1.3.2**

- Yellow, Grey and Firm Rock have a new moai icon that reads at small sizes
- Browsers without a side panel open bossdetox.ing as a small window under the toolbar icon
- The extensions page shows the bossdetox.ing monkey instead of a placeholder symbol

The ZIP below is for manual installs in developer mode. SHA-256 checksums are in `SHA256SUMS`.
